title: Sort each expression by its degree (or 'Not a polynomial')
instructions: Drag each card on the left into the correct bin. A constant is degree 0, x or 5x − 1 is degree 1 (linear), and so on. Anything with a negative power, fractional power, or variable in a denominator goes into 'Not a polynomial'.

bins.name: Degree 1 (linear)
bins.description: Largest exponent of the variable is 1.

bins.name: Degree 2 (quadratic)
bins.description: Largest exponent of the variable is 2.

bins.name: Degree 3 (cubic)
bins.description: Largest exponent of the variable is 3.

bins.name: Not a polynomial
bins.description: Has a variable in a denominator, a negative power, or a fractional power.

items.name: 2y − 7
items.explanation: Largest exponent of y is 1; linear polynomial.

items.name: p^2 − 7p
items.explanation: Largest exponent of p is 2; quadratic polynomial.

items.name: 2y^3 − y + 6
items.explanation: Largest exponent of y is 3; cubic polynomial.

items.name: x^3 + 1
items.explanation: Largest exponent of x is 3; cubic polynomial.

items.name: 3/x
items.explanation: 3/x = 3 x^(−1); negative power, so not a polynomial.

items.name: √x
items.explanation: √x = x^(1/2); fractional power, so not a polynomial.

items.name: 2/(x + 1)
items.explanation: Variable in the denominator; not a polynomial.
